faction lowered: None [ edit ] Description Kailina asks, "Do you enjoy hunting big game, adventurer?" "You may be surprised to find that swale trolls traverse these lands, and they make fine quarry. The beasts can be hard to find, but they're just the right sort of challenge for a go-it-alone hunter." "Fortunately for us, the queen is paying bounties for troll kills. Keep track of your kills with knuckles, and I'll pay out the bounty." "Be careful on your hunt, though... trolls often wander near other dangers." [ edit ] Objectives Kill swale trolls in the Marsh of Peril . Return to Kailina at the Recondite Threshold . Troll Knuckle (12) [ edit ] Upon Completion You will be given the following rewards: 500 Celestine Ward faction A coin reward of 10s Retrieved from " http://wiki.silkyvenom.com/index.php/Tolls_for_Trolls " Category : Thestra 26-30 Quests
